description: review V71 adversarial, UD-001 zero-init oracle variant: curved3d.msh (warped quadrangle_4 master facets on z = -0.15 (x^2 + y^2)), mu = 0.3, epsilon_n = 1e3, epsilon_t = 2e3, rigid master; 24 prescribed sliding steps of the upper body (shift (0.13 + 0.025 s, 0.07 + 0.0125 s, -0.02 - 0.0015 min(s, 10))) across master facet boundaries: search and force assembly per step; slip moduli of the slaves in slip at the end

build.cxx_flags: -ffp-contract=off -DEIGEN_DONT_VECTORIZE -O2 -g -DNDEBUG -g3 -ggdb3 -flarge-source-files -std=c++20 -flto=auto -fno-fat-lto-objects -fPIC -frounding-math (actual flags of src/model/solid_mechanics/solid_mechanics_model.cc; warnings and non-FP -D defines omitted)
